title: JointUnderstandingExchange
description: The handoff contract between system investigation, translation, and the developer for one Joint Understanding session (Epic #328 Phase A / Issue #329). A session starts when a developer answers 「わからない」 (trigger=unknown_answer) or explicitly asks to work something out together (explicit_request) about an existing confirmation item, and accumulates append-only findings plus the finite next actions the developer chose. Three provenances are kept strictly apart and never merged into one 'answer': investigation owns technical facts and their snapshot evidence, translation owns purpose/impact wording that may only reference existing findings, and the developer owns value judgements. The session itself never writes the origin item's answer/intent/decision -- 「わからない」 is an entry point into a shared investigation, never a recorded developer intent.

findings.description: Append-only. A correction is a NEW finding carrying supersedes_finding_id, never an edit of an existing one.

actions.description: The finite next understanding actions the developer chose, in order. Recording an action never decides the origin item.

session_id.description: The owning interview_session. A Joint Understanding session is always scoped to one interview session and one System.

origin_kind.description: Which confirmation item the developer could not answer. The origin row is only ever READ.

trigger.description: unknown_answer: the developer said 「わからない」. explicit_request: the developer asked to work it out together without having said so.

question_text.description: What the developer wants to understand. Stored on the session only -- never copied into the origin item's answer field and never recorded as a developer finding.

outcome.description: Set only when status=closed. understood/doubt_resolved record that understanding improved; hypothesis_adopted is explicitly PROVISIONAL and never a fact; decided is the developer's final value judgement; handed_off passes the decision to someone else; abandoned closes without a conclusion.

outcome_is_provisional.description: Derived, never stored as free text: true exactly for outcome=hypothesis_adopted. A provisional outcome must not be presented or reused as an established fact.

premise_snapshot_id.description: The repository snapshot this session's investigation is pinned to, captured at creation (same discipline as an Inquiry's premise bundle, Issue #308). Never rebased onto a newer snapshot mid-session.

origin_role.description: WHO produced this. investigation: technical facts read from the pinned snapshot and runtime observation. translation: purpose/impact wording derived only from other findings. developer: the human's own intent, priority, or value judgement. A role is never allowed to author another role's content.

claim_kind.description: WHAT kind of statement this is. Independent of origin_role: 'unknown' is a first-class result (evidence is missing), never plausibility-filled, and 'conflict' records two sources that cannot both hold.

evidence.description: Snapshot-verified code/doc citations. Allowed ONLY for origin_role=investigation: translation must reference findings instead of inventing citations, and a developer statement is a judgement, not snapshot evidence.

runtime_evidence.description: Runtime observation evidence, same restriction as `evidence` (investigation only).

supports_finding_ids.description: Findings of the SAME session this statement is derived from. Required (>=1) for origin_role=translation so any generalized wording can always be traced back to the original technical claim and its evidence.

competing_explanations.description: Required (>=1) for an investigation hypothesis: a hypothesis is not merely a low-confidence claim.

refutation_conditions.description: Required (>=1) for an investigation hypothesis: what would have to be observed for this to be wrong.

next_investigation.description: The next research step that would distinguish the competing explanations.

supersedes_finding_id.description: Corrections are additive: the superseded finding stays readable, this row records what replaced it.

decision_method.description: manual is reserved for origin_role=developer; a reasoning model never writes a manual record and a human record never carries an intelligence run.

intelligence_run_id.description: The reasoning run that produced this finding. Always null for origin_role=developer.

action_kind.description: The finite set of next understanding actions offered to the developer. Choosing one records intent to continue the conversation -- it never approves, adopts, or decides the origin item by itself.

decision_method.description: An action is always the human's own choice.
